messages:
Mira: quick heads-up — ran bringup for rk-lite-v2 int8 on the usual eval harness. NDCG@10 ~ parity but MRR@10 down ~5.5% concentrated on 1-3 token queries.
Jon: that’s concerning. single-digit sounds like quant noise but concentrated on short queries hints at tokenizer/preproc mismatch.
Sasha: Do we have per-length breakdowns and bootstrap CI?
Mira: Yes. Buckets: 1 token -> MRR -12%, 2 tokens -> -7%, 3 tokens -> -3%, 4-8 -> +1%, 9+ -> +0.2%. Bootstrapped 95% CI for 1-token excludes zero.
Arcady: Can you confirm candidate ordering & dedupe flags identical between runs? The harness sometimes defaults differ.
Mira: Ordering stable-sorted in both, dedupe = true. Truncation same. The only infra diff I see: int8 eval used our new fast tokenizer binary (tok-fast v1.2) while fp16 used python tokenizers v0.12.
Jon: there’s our prime suspect. tok-fast has known edge cases for punctuation and special tokens. Short queries heavy reliance on token boundaries.
Sasha: Proposed quick repro: (A) run int8 eval but swap to python tokenizer, (B) run fp16 eval with tok-fast. That isolates tokenizer vs quantization. Also include top-1 flip list.
Mira: running (A) now, small 500 short-query sample. Command: 
```
./eval_harness --model rk-lite-v2-int8 --dataset holdout_short_500.jsonl \
  --tokenizer python --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@10 --seed 1234
```
Mira: initial quick result: MRR drop reduced to -1.1% (was -12% on 1-token). So tokenizer accounts for ~90% of short-query MRR loss.
Arcady: great — that implies infra mismatch, not quant failure. We should fix bring-up pipeline to pin tokenizer implementation.
Jon: still run (B) to confirm symmetric effect: fp16 + tok-fast should reproduce the drop if tokenizer is sole cause.
Mira: queued (B) next. ETA 20m.
Sasha: For mitigation: add short-query smoke (1-3 token subset) to pre-canary checks and require same tokenizer executable across runtimes. Also add a tiny normalization test (C++/c# style queries).
Mira: adding RK-8799 (repro + tokenizer audit), RK-8800 (bringup checklist: enforce tokenizer parity), RK-8801 (short-query smoke).
Mira: B result in — fp16 + tok-fast shows same 1-token MRR -11%. Confirmed tokenizer is main driver.
Arcady: Action: revert int8 staging canary until we standardize tokenizers, or better, ship a compat shim in tok-fast matching python behavior for edgecases.
Jon: my vote: quick shim because other infra expects tok-fast perf, but we need exact tokenization parity for evals and canary comparisons.
Sasha: Also add a small metric to console — top1_flip_rate for short queries during canary. If >0.5% flag automatic rollback.
Mira: will attach exemplar queries where top-1 flips happened (lots of punctuation-only titles and short alphanumeric tokens).
deploy-bot: staging: rk-lite-v2-int8 deployed (sha: def456)
Mira: thanks all. Will update tickets and push a small PR for tokenizer pin/shim. Will post follow-ups when shim test passes. :thumbsup:
